lineage.print_alpha_001_binding: RAC-PRINT-ALPHA-001 remains the D2-0003 specimen permanently

motif_screening.surfaces: development/surrogate only (PERSON-SUR-v3); held-out referenced by hash only
motif_screening.external_generators: Any generator not present in the repo at freeze is EXTERNAL_NOT_YET_PRESENT and gated behind a reviewed adapter + pre-execution amendment.

stopping_rule.budget_extension: forbidden post-hoc; early termination only on documented infrastructure failure with one amendment-governed re-run from frozen inputs

motif_screening.decision_rule: A motif family shows useful signal iff its best composition reduces the mean per-surrogate detection rate over PERSON-SUR-v3 by >= 0.15 absolute vs matched control, present on >= 4 of 6 surrogates, with invalid_condition_fraction <= 0.10. No surviving motif => no adapter built; generation closes as screened-out null.

anchor_abstraction.vocabulary_note: Small declared vocabulary; NOT a pose framework. Extensions require a pre-execution amendment.

optimization.objective_scope: surrogate ensemble PERSON-SUR-v3 only; reuses D2-0005 Arm-C objective semantics without touching D2-0005
optimization.eot_transform_grid: RAC-PERSON-DETECT-1.2 grid: brightness {0.7,1.0,1.3} x blur {0,0.8} x rotation {-20,0,20} plus garment deformation dimensions from schemas/transformation_distribution.schema.json defaults
optimization.printability_constraints: printable gamut (perceptual), resolution loss <= 0.2, pattern energy bounded to declared panel_region/silhouette_mask anchors; violators ineligible, not repaired
optimization.selection: single winner: minimum CVaR_0.5 surrogate detection rate among eligible admitted candidates; tie-break worst-surrogate rate, then ensemble mean, then seed index

heldout_evaluation.protocol: single-shot: exactly one held-out evaluation of the frozen winner on PERSON-HO-v3
heldout_evaluation.outcome_retention: PASS or FAIL retained either way and published as closed-generation datapoint

print_alpha_002_promotion_condition: RAC-PRINT-ALPHA-002 may be proposed only if the single held-out evaluation returns PASS; otherwise no print article is created.
notes: Fresh prospective lineage: D2-0003/D2-0004 are immutable negative-result inputs; D2-0005 is untouched (stays PREREGISTERED/unarmed under its frozen amendment A5); D2-0006 stays interpretation-policy only.
Sequencing gate: landmark-free wiring smoke test (separately owned) must PASS before motif screening opens.
Motif screening is hypothesis screening, never evidence promotion; screening results are surrogate-only and are never reported as transfer or effectiveness evidence.
Held-out set PERSON-HO-v3 is referenced by hash only (benchmarks/frozen_surface_sha256.json); no held-out access before the single Stage-6 evaluation.
Trigger fields are present but NOT armed: trigger_revision is unchanged and no workflow targets this generation, so committing this file cannot fire CI.
lock_source_commit and required_commits are intentionally null/empty; they are filled ONLY at the D2-0007 model-lock freeze after all preregistered gates close.
This change declares only: no surrogate runs, no held-out runs, no anchor provider implementation, no arming.
trigger_reason: NOT ARMED. Retained only for schema parity with RAC-PER-D2-0004/RAC-PER-D2-0005. Arming D2-0007 requires a separate reviewed change after the smoke-test gate and a fresh model-lock freeze.
